title: Signal: Regular expression built from a non-literal (javascript)
scope: Single-line lexical match on RegExp constructors with a non-literal first argument.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: flags any non-literal RegExp argument. Whether the value is attacker-controlled is not analysed.

examples.line: # audit: const re = new RegExp(req.query.q); present

fpNotes: Patterns assembled from constants inside the module are the common false positive.
